headline: Student · Founder, Code Caravan · Secretary-General, TuronMUN
summary: Student at the Presidential School in Fergana (Economics & Computer Science). Organizes hackathons and Model UN conferences for young people in Uzbekistan's regions, and builds the software that runs them.

experience.about: Hackathons for students in Uzbekistan's regions, where such events are rare.
points: Organized 3 hackathons (Code Caravan I, II and TECH4REGION) for 400+ participants in 85+ teams across Fergana and Andijan.
Raised $10,000+ in prizes and grants from partners including the Andijan Regional Administration, IT Park Andijan and the Goethe-Institut Tashkent.
Secured partnerships with 2 government organizations and 4 NGOs.
Directed 6 conferences for 1,000+ delegates, leading a 20+ member team across 4 departments.
Raised $2,000+ and secured support from 1 government organization and 3 NGOs.

projects.name: TuronMUN Platform
projects.description: Website, delegate registration and admin system for Turon Model United Nations; 1,000+ delegates registered.

projects.name: Vibd
projects.description: Platform where volunteers and early-career talent prove their skills through real work, and organizations hire from verified impact history. Includes AI skill matching and a job chatbot.

projects.name: MuAIlim
projects.description: AI-powered exam preparation app for students in Uzbekistan.

honors.title: Regional Informatics Olympiad
honors.detail: 1st place (2022), 2nd place (2023), 3rd place (2024), among 300–400 students each year
